name: io.github.geolens-io/geolens
title: GeoLens
description: Read-only access to a self-hosted GeoLens spatial catalog: datasets, features, maps, sandboxed SQL.

environmentVariables.name: GEOLENS_INSTANCE
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the GeoLens instance, e.g. https://geolens.example.com (the /api suffix is appended automatically).

environmentVariables.name: GEOLENS_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key, sent as X-Api-Key. Omit for public-only access.

environmentVariables.name: GEOLENS_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: JWT bearer token, used only when GEOLENS_API_KEY is unset.
